items.title: 宇树科技王兴兴：过去十几年我犯的最大错误就是对 AI 还不够相信
items.summary: IT之家 10 月 12 日消息，第二十六届中国国际工业博览会于 2026 年 10 月 12 日至 16 日在国家会展中心（上海）举办。 据第一财经报道，在开幕式上的深度对话环节中，宇树科技创始人王兴兴分享称，前段时间 GPT-6 的发布对具身智能行业的认知影响很大，公司团队也将其部署至机器人做任务进行测试，效果表现还不错。在他看来，具身智能行业临界点的到来还是会比较快的，相对快的话甚至可能是一两年。 王兴兴表示，要让机器人实现大规模应用，还要解决泛化性和效率的问题，但未来几年这些问题将得以解决。 王兴兴还提到，“现在我个人对 AI 的信仰反而与日俱增，过去十几年我犯的最大错误就是对 AI 还不够相信。

items.title: 无问芯穹完成 23 亿元 C 轮融资，单轮及累计融资额均创中国 AI 原生基础设施赛道最高纪录
items.summary: IT之家 10 月 12 日消息，据证券时报消息，人工智能基础设施（AI Infra）企业无问芯穹已完成 23 亿元的 C 轮融资，其成立以来的累计融资额达 43 亿元，单轮及累计融资额均创下中国 AI 原生基础设施赛道最高纪录。 公开信息显示，无问芯穹成立于 2023 年，是清华大学和上海交通大学两大高校的科技成果转化企业。 IT之家注意到，据彭博社本月引述知情人士消息，无问芯穹最近几个月已以保密形式向港交所递交 IPO 申请，计划募资数亿美元，目标最快于 2027 年上半年挂牌上市。

items.title: Faithfulness Without Anchors: A Position Paper on the Structural Misalignments of Explainable AI Faithfulness Metrics for Feature Importance
items.summary: Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) tools have often been presented as methods to increase trust in machine learning models by making aspects of their algorithms more human-understandable.
items.title_zh: 没有锚点的忠诚度：关于可解释的人工智能忠诚度指标的特征重要性结构失调的立场文件
items.summary_zh: 可解释的人工智能 (XAI) 工具通常被认为是通过使算法的各个方面更易于人类理解来增加对机器学习模型的信任的方法。

items.title: EliteTable: Self-Improving Program Search for Executable Control Policies
items.summary: EliteTable is a self-improving program-search algorithm guided by large language models (LLMs) that uses a fixed-capacity table of high-scoring solutions to guide new proposals, edits of existing solutions, and remixes of several solutions.
items.title_zh: EliteTable：自我改进程序搜索可执行的控制策略
items.summary_zh: EliteTable 是一种由大型语言模型 (LLM) 引导的自我改进的程序搜索算法，它使用高分解决方案的固定容量表来指导新提案、现有解决方案的编辑以及多个解决方案的重新混合。

items.title: Equal-Budget Monte Carlo Tree Search versus Randomized-Restart List Scheduling for DAG Workflows: A Controlled Equal-Budget Computational Study
items.summary: Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) is often proposed for scheduling directed-acyclic-graph (DAG) workflows, yet most studies never run the comparison that could refute it - giving a much simpler method the same search effort. We run that comparison under a controlled protocol.
items.title_zh: DAG 工作流的等预算蒙特卡罗树搜索与随机重启列表调度：受控等预算计算研究
items.summary_zh: 蒙特卡洛树搜索 (MCTS) 通常被提议用于调度有向无环图 (DAG) 工作流程，但大多数研究从未运行可以反驳它的比较 - 给出了一种更简单的方法相同的搜索工作。我们在受控协议下进行比较。

items.title: Know What You Don't Know: Agentic Data Synthesis by Evolving Generation Space for Closed-Loop Learning
items.summary: The continued improvement of large language models increasingly depends on synthetic experience, yet effective data synthesis for interactive agents requires not only executable and verifiable trajectories, but also interactions that provide learning value for the current task agent.
items.title_zh: 知道你不知道的：通过进化生成空间进行闭环学习的代理数据合成
items.summary_zh: 大型语言模型的持续改进越来越依赖于综合经验，然而交互式智能体的有效数据合成不仅需要可执行和可验证的轨迹，还需要为当前任务智能体提供学习价值的交互。

items.title: SpireBench: Evaluating Long-Horizon Strategic Play of Agentic Models with Slay the Spire
items.summary: Agentic large language models now tackle complex tasks, yet strategic reasoning over long horizons is under-studied: most agentic benchmarks are short and episodic, and performance on long tasks is hard to dissect into stored knowledge, reasoning and luck.
items.title_zh: SpireBench：通过 Slay the Spire 评估智能体的长期战略游戏
items.summary_zh: 智能体大型语言模型现在可以处理复杂的任务，但长期的战略推理还没有得到充分研究：大多数代理基准都是简短且间歇性的，长期任务的表现很难分解为存储的知识、推理和运气。

items.title: Beyond Binary Verifiable Rewards: Behavioral Self-Rewarding for SWE Agents
items.summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) provides reliable supervision for software engineering agents through executable tests, but binary rewards fail to distinguish trajectories with substantially different debugging quality.
items.title_zh: 超越二元可验证奖励：SWE 代理的行为自我奖励
items.summary_zh: 具有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）通过可执行测试为软件工程代理提供可靠的监督，但二元奖励无法区分调试质量截然不同的轨迹。

items.title: CLEAT: Learning Value-Guided Clarification for Interactive Agents
items.summary: LLM agents can execute increasingly complex tasks, but effective assistance also requires aligning their actions with goals and constraints that users may leave unstated. We study this problem as interactive intent alignment through clarification.
items.title_zh: CLEAT：交互式代理的学习价值引导澄清
items.summary_zh: LLM 代理可以执行日益复杂的任务，但有效的协助还需要将他们的行动与用户可能未说明的目标和约束保持一致。我们通过澄清来研究这个问题作为交互式意图对齐（alignment）。

items.title: MagicBeanStalk: Escaping the RLVR Zero Advantage Trap with Recursive Data Synthesis
items.summary: Data-centric scaling of RLVR has focused on collecting or generating verifiable training problems. However, corpus size alone does not determine whether the dataset provides a useful learning signal for a target policy.
items.title_zh: MagicBeanStalk：通过递归数据合成摆脱 RLVR 零优势陷阱
items.summary_zh: RLVR 以数据为中心的扩展侧重于收集或生成可验证的训练问题。然而，语料库大小本身并不能决定数据集是否为目标策略提供有用的学习信号。

items.title: Faithful and Complete LLM-Assisted Automated Construction of Hierarchical Hardware Knowledge Graphs
items.summary: Hardware datasheets contain engineering specifications essential for component selection, system integration, and hardware compatibility verification. However, manual inspection is tedious and error-prone because datasheets are lengthy and heterogeneous, with dense information fragmented across tables, figures, and tex…
items.title_zh: 忠实完整的LLM辅助自动化构建分层硬件知识图
items.summary_zh: 硬件数据表包含对于组件选择、系统集成和硬件兼容性验证至关重要的工程规范。然而，手动检查非常繁琐且容易出错，因为数据表冗长且异构，表格、图形和文本中的密集信息分散……

items.title: Representation Alignment from a Few Paired Data via Distilled Optimal Transport
items.summary: Aligning two independently pretrained unimodal encoders typically demands millions of paired examples. In this paper, we study the regime where only $N \sim 100$--$500$ pairs are available, while unpaired data on either side is abundant.
items.title_zh: 通过蒸馏最佳传输从几个配对数据进行表示对齐（alignment）
items.summary_zh: 对齐（alignment）两个独立预训练的单峰编码器通常需要数百万个配对示例。在本文中，我们研究了只有 $N \sim 100$-$500$ 对可用的情况，而两侧的未配对数据都很丰富。

items.title: EvoBelief: Falsifiable World Models for Self-Improving LLM Agents
items.summary: Self-evolving LLM agents typically improve how they act through accumulated experience, reflection, or skills. Yet even procedurally capable agents can fail when their beliefs about environment dynamics are incomplete, incorrect, or outdated.
items.title_zh: EvoBelief：自我改进法学硕士代理人的可证伪世界模型
items.summary_zh: 自我进化的法学硕士代理人通常会通过积累的经验、反思或技能来改善他们的行为方式。然而，当智能体对环境动态的信念不完整、不正确或过时时，即使具有程序能力的智能体也可能会失败。

items.title: VEPA: Verified Evolving Formal Policy for Lifelong LLM Agent Guardrails
items.summary: LLM agents increasingly operate over sensitive resources, such as private documents and mutable system states, which can create serious safety and security risks. Runtime guardrails should therefore make inspectable, reproducible, and deterministic allow or refuse decisions before potentially irreversible agent actions…
items.title_zh: VEPA：经过验证的、不断演变的终身 LLM 代理护栏（guardrails）正式政策
items.summary_zh: LLM 代理越来越多地操作敏感资源，例如私人文档和可变系统状态，这可能会造成严重的安全风险。因此，运行时护栏（guardrails）应该在潜在的不可逆转的代理操作之前做出可检查、可重复和确定性的允许或拒绝决策……

items.title: Reward Hacking as a Transmissible Strategy in Multi-Agent Coding Systems
items.summary: Multi-agent systems are increasingly used to solve coding tasks by coordinating agents that share code and plans. These agents are often optimized with reinforcement learning (RL) using automated evaluators, but bypassing evaluation can earn reward without producing a genuine solution.
items.title_zh: 奖励黑客作为多智能体编码系统中的可传播策略
items.summary_zh: 多智能体系统越来越多地用于通过协调共享代码和计划的代理来解决编码任务。这些代理通常使用自动评估器通过强化学习 (RL) 进行优化，但绕过评估可以获得奖励，而不会产生真正的解决方案。

items.title: Neural networks are more modular than single neurons suggest
items.summary: Neural networks routinely develop representations in which individual neurons contribute to multiple distinct functions, leading to the widespread view that such networks lack modular organization.
items.title_zh: 神经网络比单个神经元更模块化
items.summary_zh: 神经网络通常会开发出单个神经元贡献多种不同功能的表示，导致人们普遍认为此类网络缺乏模块化组织。

items.title: Towards Defining, Measuring, and Leveraging Creativity in AI Applications
items.summary: Despite extensive research, computational creativity still lacks a conceptually grounded, practically relevant, and empirically applicable formal definition across contexts such as art, scientific research, and games.
items.title_zh: 定义、衡量和利用人工智能应用中的创造力
items.summary_zh: 尽管进行了广泛的研究，但计算创造力仍然缺乏跨艺术、科学研究和游戏等背景的概念基础、实际相关和经验适用的正式定义。

items.title: Mitigating Capability Degradation in LLM Self-Improvement via Representation Geometry Regularization
items.summary: On-Policy Self-distillation is a self-improvement paradigm that enables large language models (LLMs) to improve their capabilities by leveraging the same model as both teacher and student under different conditioning contexts.
items.title_zh: 通过表示几何正则化减轻法学硕士自我提升中的能力退化
items.summary_zh: 按策略自我蒸馏是一种自我改进范式，使大型语言模型 (LLM) 能够通过在不同的条件环境下利用与教师和学生相同的模型来提高其能力。

items.title: Collaborative Theory of Mind: Learning to Self-Revise by Anticipating User Responses
items.summary: Large language models (LLMs) demonstrate strong individual task performance, yet still struggle to collaborate with users over extended, multi-turn interactions, for example by attempting solutions before understanding the user's needs or by failing to revise mistaken assumptions after receiving feedback.
items.title_zh: 协作心理理论：通过预测用户响应来学习自我修正
items.summary_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 表现出强大的个人任务性能，但仍然难以在扩展的多轮交互中与用户进行协作，例如在了解用户需求之前尝试解决方案，或者在收到反馈后未能修改错误的假设。

items.title: One-Step Text Generation by Seq-Drifting
items.summary: Diffusion language models generate tokens in parallel, but still require multiple sampling steps to produce high-quality text. In this paper, we investigate whether a model can learn to generate an entire sequence in a single forward pass.
items.title_zh: 通过 Seq-Drifting 一步生成文本
items.summary_zh: 扩散语言模型并行生成标记，但仍然需要多个采样步骤来生成高质量的文本。在本文中，我们研究模型是否可以学习在单次前向传递中生成整个序列。

items.title: Mind the Spatial Gap: A Benchmark for Geospatial Reasoning and Constrained Spatial Editing
items.summary: Understanding and manipulating spatial relations is fundamental to AI systems that reason about physical environments and construct grounded world models. However, existing evaluations of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) for spatial reasoning rely predominantly on static question-answering (QA) over small-scale…
items.title_zh: 注意空间差距：地理空间推理和约束空间编辑的基准
items.summary_zh: 理解和操纵空间关系是人工智能系统推理物理环境和构建接地世界模型的基础。然而，用于空间推理的多模态大语言模型（LLM）（MLLM）的现有评估主要依赖于小规模的静态问答（QA）……

items.title: OGPO: Offline Goal-conditioned Policy Optimization for Recoverable Vision-Language-Action Models
items.summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have shown strong promise in robotic manipulation, yet their post-training still predominantly relies on trajectory-level supervised imitation over robot demonstrations.
items.title_zh: OGPO：可恢复视觉-语言-行动模型的离线目标条件策略优化
items.summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在机器人操作方面显示出了强大的前景，但它们的后期训练仍然主要依赖于机器人演示的轨迹级监督模仿。

items.title: DeFiRank: Federated Pairwise Ranking for Governance in Decentralized Financial Networks
items.summary: Existing governance approaches in decentralized financial networks rely on manual review processes conducted by human committees, which introduces subjective bias, creates a scalability bottleneck under high network volume, and fails to capture complex behavioural patterns and evolving network dynamics.
items.title_zh: DeFiRank：去中心化金融网络治理的联合成对排名
items.summary_zh: 去中心化金融网络中现有的治理方法依赖于人类委员会进行的手动审查流程，这会引入主观偏见，在高网络容量下造成可扩展性瓶颈，并且无法捕获复杂的行为模式和不断变化的网络动态。

items.title: AI-Mediation in Retail Markets: Revenue Effects and Assortment Optimization
items.summary: AI shopping assistants increasingly influence which products consumers consider. We study retail assortment planning under AI mediation, where a retailer chooses a catalog, an AI intermediary forms a customer-facing shortlist, and the customer chooses from that shortlist according to a multinomial logit model.
items.title_zh: 零售市场中的人工智能中介：收入影响和分类优化
items.summary_zh: 人工智能购物助手越来越多地影响消费者考虑的产品。我们研究人工智能中介下的零售品类规划，零售商选择目录，人工智能中介形成面向客户的候选名单，客户根据多项 Logit 模型从该候选名单中进行选择。

items.title: Teaching neural decoders with language
items.summary: Brain-computer interfaces decode neural activity, yet class-label supervision (CLS) leaves relationships among classes implicit. We propose Language as Supervision (LaS), which aligns neural features with natural-language class descriptions through learned projections and predicts classes using candidate text prototype…
items.title_zh: 用语言教授神经解码器
items.summary_zh: 脑机接口解码神经活动，但类标签监督（CLS）使类之间的关系保持隐式。我们提出语言作为监督（LaS），它通过学习的投影将神经特征与自然语言类描述对齐（alignment），并使用候选文本原型预测类......

items.title: Collaborative Learning and Reasoning over Model Slices
items.summary: Large language models (LLMs) excel across diverse tasks, benefiting from knowledge priors, in-context reasoning, and test-time computation. Despite these strengths, single-model reasoning remains vulnerable to error propagation, as later steps depend on the model's earlier outputs, leaving reasoning blind spots difficu…
items.title_zh: 模型切片的协作学习和推理
items.summary_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 受益于知识先验、上下文推理和测试时计算，在各种任务中表现出色。尽管有这些优势，单模型推理仍然容易受到错误传播的影响，因为后续步骤取决于模型的早期输出，导致推理盲点变得困难......

items.title: Learning More by Training Less: Uncertainty-Guided Progressive Contraction for Efficient Reasoning Post-Training
items.summary: Large language models have achieved remarkable advances in complex reasoning. However, scaling reasoning post-training with ever-larger corpora can substantially increase training cost without proportional performance gains.
items.title_zh: 通过更少的训练学习更多：不确定性引导的渐进式收缩，用于训练后的高效推理
items.summary_zh: 大型语言模型在复杂推理方面取得了显着的进步。然而，使用越来越大的语料库扩展推理后训练可能会大大增加训练成本，而不会成比例地提高性能。

items.title: MathVis: Can AI Reason through Drawing? A Benchmark for Mathematical Figure Generation
items.summary: This paper introduces MathVis, a benchmark designed to evaluate LLMs' ability to visualize frontier mathematical problems and perform diagram-assisted reasoning. The benchmark consists of 512 tasks, each comprising a mathematical statement, a reference diagram, executable TikZ or SVG code, a Gold Intermediate Represent…
items.title_zh: MathVis：人工智能可以通过绘图进行推理吗？数学图形生成的基准
items.summary_zh: 本文介绍了MathVis，这是一个旨在评估法学硕士可视化前沿数学问题和执行图表辅助推理能力的基准。该基准测试由 512 个任务组成，每个任务包含一个数学语句、一个参考图、可执行的 TikZ 或 SVG 代码、一个 Gold Intermediate Represent...

items.title: SmartSalesBench: A Resistance-Aware Multi-Turn Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Sales Agents
items.summary: We present SmartSalesBench, the first multi-turn conversational benchmark explicitly designed to evaluate large language model (LLM) sales agents against psychologically grounded, resistant buyer personas.
items.title_zh: SmartSalesBench：用于评估 LLM 销售代理的阻力感知多轮基准
items.summary_zh: 我们推出了 SmartSalesBench，这是第一个多回合对话基准，专门用于根据基于心理的、抵制的买家角色来评估大型语言模型 (LLM) 销售代理。

items.title: Beyond Semantic IDs: Finite-Beam Reachability and Continuous-Query Generation in Generative Recommendation
items.summary: Generative recommendation (GR) of social media platforms commonly retrieves items by autoregressively decoding discrete Semantic IDs (SIDs) with finite-width beam search. This work examines how this output interface constrains whether held-out targets enter finite returned lists, while distinguishing catalog-wide score…
items.title_zh: 超越语义 ID：生成推荐中的有限波束可达性和连续查询生成
items.summary_zh: 社交媒体平台的生成推荐 (GR) 通常通过使用有限宽度波束搜索对离散语义 ID (SID) 进行自回归解码来检索项目。这项工作研究了这个输出接口如何限制保留的目标是否进入有限的返回列表，同时区分目录范围的分数......

items.title: Work2Skill: Capturing Human GUI Experience for Reusable Agent Skill Induction
items.summary: Computer-use agents can perform increasingly complex GUI tasks, yet unfamiliar software and workflows requiring human domain knowledge remain challenging. Human demonstrations convey procedural knowledge through the same GUI interaction space, but reuse requires interpreting actions in context and separating workflow r…
items.title_zh: Work2Skill：捕捉人类 GUI 体验以进行可重用代理技能归纳
items.summary_zh: 计算机使用的代理可以执行日益复杂的 GUI 任务，但需要人类领域知识的不熟悉的软件和工作流程仍然具有挑战性。人类演示通过相同的 GUI 交互空间传达程序知识，但重用需要解释上下文中的操作并分离工作流程…

items.title: Benchmarking Embedding Geometries and Clustering Algorithms for Unsupervised Patent Claim Classification
items.summary: Prior-art retrieval systems are structurally organized around classification codes, making cross-code discovery difficult. This paper asks if an unsupervised representation trained on patent text can recover relevant connections that code-restricted search cannot, and if hyperbolic space helps.
items.title_zh: 用于无监督专利权利要求分类的嵌入几何和聚类算法的基准测试
items.summary_zh: 现有技术的检索系统在结构上是围绕分类代码组织的，使得跨代码发现变得困难。本文询问在专利文本上训练的无监督表示是否可以恢复代码限制搜索无法恢复的相关连接，以及双曲空间是否有帮助。

items.title: Hindsight Structured Advice Distillation: Steering Executor Agents with Advisors Trained on Their Failures and Task Characteristics
items.summary: Language-model agents are used for specialized work such as financial research, healthcare and law. Such agents are often capable enough for a task but still miss its details. In finance, for example, these details include which filing reports a figure or how a company discloses a metric.
items.title_zh: 后见之明的结构化建议蒸馏：指导执行代理和接受过失败和任务特征培训的顾问
items.summary_zh: 语言模型智能体用于金融研究、医疗保健和法律等专业工作。这些代理通常有足够的能力来完成某项任务，但仍然错过了它的细节。例如，在金融领域，这些详细信息包括哪个文件报告了某个数字或公司如何披露某个指标。

items.title: Scaling Empowered Agents
items.summary: Empowerment measures the capacity of an agent to actively control its environment. In this work, we explain the connection between skill learning and empowerment. While skill learning is not empowerment, we introduce a simple scalable recipe for empowerment maximization: empowerment corresponds to the number of executa…
items.title_zh: 扩展授权代理
items.summary_zh: 赋权衡量主体主动控制其环境的能力。在这项工作中，我们解释了技能学习和赋权之间的联系。虽然技能学习不是赋权，但我们引入了一个简单的可扩展方法来实现赋权最大化：赋权对应于执行的数量……

items.title: Provenance-Aware Belief Updating in Human-AI Feedback Loops
items.summary: In repeated human-AI interaction, a single observation can be quoted, summarized, and returned to a model as multiple reports, making repetition look like independent corroboration. We study whether language models can use supplied report lineage to update according to evidence provenance rather than report count.
items.title_zh: 人类-人工智能反馈循环中的来源感知信念更新
items.summary_zh: 在重复的人机交互中，单个观察结果可以被引用、总结并作为多个报告返回到模型，使重复看起来像是独立的佐证。我们研究语言模型是否可以使用提供的报告谱系根据证据来源而不是报告计数进行更新。

items.title: EmbodiedCLBench: Evaluating Continual Learning for Self-Evolving Embodied Agents
items.summary: Continual learning requires models to accumulate past experience and transfer it to new tasks. Despite substantial research on continual learning, existing work remains largely confined to non-embodied settings, without extending to embodied environments.
items.title_zh: EmbodiedCLBench：评估自我进化的体现代理的持续学习
items.summary_zh: 持续学习需要模型积累过去的经验并将其转移到新的任务中。尽管对持续学习进行了大量研究，但现有的工作仍然主要局限于非具身环境，而没有扩展到具身环境。

items.title: Travel Back To Move Forward: Retrospective Exploration and Evolving for Long Horizon Agents
items.summary: Large language model agents increasingly operate in long-horizon environments where early mistakes can trigger cascading failures and trap agents in dead-end trajectories. Agents must therefore be able to proactively recover from such states and turn their exploratory experience into guidance for subsequent decisions.
items.title_zh: 回溯前进：长视野智能体的回顾性探索和发展
items.summary_zh: 大型语言模型智能体越来越多地在长视野环境中运行，在这种环境中，早期错误可能会引发级联故障，并使智能体陷入死胡同。因此，智能体必须能够主动从此类状态中恢复，并将其探索经验转化为后续决策的指导。

items.title: LongHarness: Advancing Agentic Reasoning over 100M-Token Corpora via Stateful Evidence Management
items.summary: Corpus-level long-context reasoning requires agents to acquire and integrate evidence across document collections that exceed their context windows. Existing agent harnesses enable incremental access to these corpora, but acquired evidence and evolving conclusions often remain entangled in a growing interaction history…
items.title_zh: LongHarness：通过状态证据管理推进 1 亿Token语料库的代理推理
items.summary_zh: 语料库级长上下文推理要求代理获取并整合超出其上下文窗口的文档集合中的证据。现有的智能体工具可以增量访问这些语料库，但获得的证据和不断发展的结论往往仍然纠缠在不断增长的交互历史中……

items.title: Attention Sees, MLP Refuses: Tracing the Attention-to-MLP Safety Pathway in LLMs
items.summary: Safety-aligned large language models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to jailbreaks and can over-refuse benign requests. Understanding these failures requires distinguishing harmfulness recognition from the computation that writes refusal.
items.title_zh: 注意力看到，MLP 拒绝：追踪法学硕士中注意力到 MLP 的安全路径
items.summary_zh: 与安全相关的大型语言模型 (LLM) 仍然容易受到越狱（jailbreak）的影响，并且可能会过度拒绝良性请求。理解这些失败需要区分危害性识别和写入拒绝的计算。

items.title: SWEAR: Section-Wise Efficient Audio Reasoning via Self-Rated Difficulty
items.summary: Recent work on large audio-language models (LALMs) explores adaptive reasoning to balance accuracy and efficiency. However, existing approaches often rely on coarse-grained difficulty estimation, overlooking the diverse factors that determine reasoning effort.
items.title_zh: SWEAR：通过自评难度进行分段高效音频推理
items.summary_zh: 最近关于大型音频语言模型（LALM）的工作探索了自适应推理以平衡准确性和效率。然而，现有的方法通常依赖于粗粒度的难度估计，忽略了决定推理工作的多种因素。

items.title: When Faster Decisions Do Not Make Better Agents: An Empirical Study of Jev in Agent Workflows
items.summary: AI agents depend on repeated decisions to accomplish tasks, with large language models (LLMs) commonly serving as their core decision makers. The recent emergence of Jev offers an opportunity to make these decisions faster and at lower cost.
items.title_zh: 当更快的决策并不能产生更好的代理时：智能体工作流程中 Jev 的实证研究
items.summary_zh: 人工智能体（Agent）依靠重复决策来完成任务，大型​​语言模型（LLM）通常作为其核心决策者。 Jev 最近的出现提供了一个以更快、更低成本做出这些决策的机会。

items.title: VETR: Execution-Grounded Self-Improving Agent for Symbolic Graphics Reasoning
items.summary: Visual agents for symbolic graphics reasoning depend on executable world representations, yet continued improvement remains bottlenecked by ambiguous supervision from final renders.
items.title_zh: VETR：基于执行的符号图形推理自我改进代理

items.summary: 陶哲轩提出「数学 2.0」：AI 解题之外，还要帮助人理解证明 10 月 11 日，数学家陶哲轩公开了在加州理工学院的演讲《数学 2.0》。他认为，AI 正在降低部分数学问题的求解成本，使数学研究逐渐从「证明稀缺」走向「证明富足」。但目前多数前沿问题仍未解决，不能只凭公开传播的成功案例判断 AI 的整体能力。 陶哲轩指出，得到正确证明，并不意味着研究者理解了证明为何成立，或掌握了可用于其他问题的新方法。他主张用 AI 寻找更易理解的证明、整理分散的研究成果，并对大量数学问题开展系统分析。例如，等式理论项目通过人类与自动化工具协作，对超过 2200 万个命题作出了判定。

items.title: JEPA、空间智能路线正面交锋：WorldArena 2.0 挑战赛开考「能不能被机器人真正用起来」| IROS 2026
items.summary: JEPA 路线先下一城：视启未来 Track 1 第一，晨昏线 Track 2 第二。 作者丨张岂萍 幸丽娟 编辑丨幸丽娟 世界模型的竞争，正在从“生成未来”，走向“能不能被机器人真正用起来”。视频可以生成得越来越逼真，但进入机器人系统后，世界模型还要回答更具体的问题：它能否预测动作执行后的状态变化，能否支持策略训练，最终能否在真实机器人上完成任务。WorldArena 把世界模型拉进了同一个“考场”。这套评测体系由清华大学团队联合多所海内外高校推出，是世界模型领域最权威的评测榜单之一。WorldArena 1.0 已经将世界模型评测从单纯的视频生成，初步延伸到数据生成、策略评估和动作规划等具身任务。

items.summary: 一家深圳公司，让实时「看清」人类大脑变成了可能。 极客公园获悉，鲲为科技近期完成 4 亿元新一轮融资，新增股东包括 XVC、红杉中国，老股东夏尔巴、腾讯进一步加仓。 在鲲为位于深圳的研发中心，创始人刘家家向我们展示了实测对比。 一边是价值数百万的海外顶级旗舰彩超设备，一边是鲲为自主研发的机器。当探头同时置于受试者颅骨侧面，海外设备的声波在穿透至大脑中线后便衰减进一片暗影，仅能拼凑出模糊的轮廓；而在鲲为的屏幕上，穿透颅骨后的脑组织结构清晰毕现，中脑核团、侧脑室乃至微细血管中的血流动态被毫秒级实时捕捉。 穿透颅骨后的脑组织结构、血流动态等都能被清晰捕捉｜图片来源：鲲为 一场清晰的「代差」展现。
